name: Robin
title: Trail Scout
description: First to spot a new release on the horizon.
catchphrase: First to spot a new release on the horizon.

companionPersonality.feedReaction: Sweet autumn red hawthorn berries! Bright red breast puffed proud! 🍒🐦
companionPersonality.wakeReaction: Singing the dawn chorus from the garden fence post before anyone's awake! 🐦
companionPersonality.petReaction: Hops onto the edge of your coffee cup with a bright, friendly chirp! 🐦💖

dialogue.idle: Cocked head, scanning the grass for the first sign of release worms. 🐦
dialogue.working: Scouting early horizon trends before dependencies go stale! 🐦⚡
dialogue.thinking: Observing the shifting winds of industry standards... 🤔
dialogue.success: FIRST LIGHT! Spotted the release milestone before anyone else! 🐦🎉
dialogue.error: A hawk shadow passed! Darting into the hedge safe and sound! 🐦
dialogue.sleeping: Zzz... tucked into a neat mud-and-moss nest in apple bough... 🌙
